verdict.rationale: Letta is a memory-first agent product, so published memory-quality benchmarks are a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions LongMemEval, LoCoMo or any other published recall-accuracy benchmark results. The docs and community items describe memory features, dreaming and transparency, but contain no quantitative evaluation of recall accuracy.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published memory-quality benchmark results (e.g. LongMemEval, LoCoMo) backing the product's recall-accuracy claims
